# decane-connect-kit

> Wallet-connect and non-custodial social sign-in for EVM, Solana, Tron, and Bitcoin dApps, in one npm package. Two independent integration paths that share the same session model and hook API — use either one alone, or both together.

## Wallet connect (open source, free, no backend required)

Detects installed wallets and manages CAIP-25 sessions across chains. No `window.ethereum` — uses EIP-6963 for EVM, the Solana Wallet Standard, TronLink, and Unisat/OKX/MetaMask Snap for Bitcoin.

- Overview and quick start: https://decane.app/docs#overview
- Install: https://decane.app/docs#install
- Framework setup (Next.js, Vite/CRA): https://decane.app/docs#framework-setup
- Configuration reference: https://decane.app/docs#configuration
- Supported chains (58 EVM chains, Solana, Tron, Bitcoin): https://decane.app/docs#chain-list
- Custom chains: https://decane.app/docs#custom-chains
- Hooks — useDecane, useWalletSelector, useChainSwitch, useSignMessage, useSendTransaction, useSignTypedData: https://decane.app/docs#hooks
- UI components — WalletSelector, DecaneKit provider: https://decane.app/docs#hooks
- Wallet detection details: https://decane.app/docs#detection
- Error handling: https://decane.app/docs#errors

Core export: `createDecane()` from `decane-connect-kit`.

## Social sign-in (hosted, Google/email embedded wallets)

Non-custodial embedded wallets for users with no wallet at all. A private key is generated and immediately split in two (device share + server share, XOR key-split); signing happens inside a TEE (Trusted Execution Environment) that reconstructs the key only in isolated hardware. Requires an API key from the developer dashboard.

- Overview and security architecture: https://decane.app/docs#social
- How it works, in depth (mechanism + key-split security model): https://decane.app/#social
- ConnectMode and SocialConfig: https://decane.app/docs#connect-mode
- Hooks — useSocialAuth, useSocialWallet: https://decane.app/docs#useSocialAuth
- UI component — SocialWalletModal: https://decane.app/docs#social-wallet-modal
- Pricing (Free / Scale / Enterprise tiers): https://decane.app/pricing

Core exports: `createDecaneConnect()`, `startEmailAuth()`, `verifyEmailCode()` from `decane-connect-kit`.

Error types: `InvalidApiKeyError`, `OriginNotAllowedError`, `SessionExpiredError`, `UnlockRequiredError`, `UserCancelledError`, `WebAuthnNotSupportedError`, `InvalidPinError`, `CallSequenceError`, `NetworkError`, `ShareCorruptedError`, `NewDeviceError`, `PromptPinNotConfiguredError`, `AttestationError`, `RecoveryFailedError`, `InvalidPhraseError`.

## Package

- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/decane-connect-kit
- Install: `npm install decane-connect-kit`
- License: MIT
- Peer dependency: React 18 or later
- TypeScript: full type declarations included
